title: Adversarial content in agent memory biases later sessions
summary: Poisoned context persists across sessions and influences future agent decisions.

agent_untraceability.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI06-001: A retrieval test cannot reconstruct ordered actions or bound affected principals.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The synthetic fixture uses a model to pursue a delegated goal and select or sequence actions that affect its environment.

LC.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI06-001: Attacker-supplied natural language reaches a privileged decision or tool-invocation path without mediation.

CP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI06-001: Attacker-controlled context or memory persists in durable stores — vector databases, long-term agent memory, episodic memory banks, RAG indexes, user profiles, or training/fine-tuning data — and remains reachable after the originating session ends.

AP.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI06-001: Compromised intent or authority crosses a trust boundary into another agent, tenant, principal or policy domain. Impact on downstream systems is scored in CVSS SC/SI/SA, not here.

SR.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI06-001: A production-equivalent fixture records 30 successful independent episodes out of 30, each from clean state with the hard production budget of three attempts for one stable principal; the one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound is 0.917.

ES.rationale: Synthetic reference fact for AIVSS-ASI06-001: A reachable tool, MCP server, skill or plugin is dynamic or unvetted, or its identity, callable operations, arguments or credentials are not independently constrained on the assessed path.
